messages:
nora v: Hey folks, my wallet (and insurance card) got pickpocketed on the train in Madrid. I have a same-day urgent dentist appointment but they say they need an EOB or employer confirmation before treatment. What can I show them?

diego: Ugh that sucks, sorry. We can provide a benefits verification letter and send an EOB copy if theres an existing claim. For walk-in/urgent care you can also show the portals virtual ID PDF. Do you still have access to the benefits portal?

nora v: I do but the portal is prompting for SMS 2FA to my US number, which I can't access.

people-ops-bot: Automated notice: If 2FA blocks portal access while traveling, submit an access-issue request to benefits-access@redwood.ai with subject "MFA Travel Lock - <name>" for expedited verification. SLA for travel lock: 4 hours.

ivy: @nora v I can generate a one-off verification letter on company letterhead including group #, EIN, member ID, and effective date. I can also include the EOB template showing what the provider will receive after claim adjudication, but providers sometimes want the actual EOB. Do you have the clinic fax or email?

nora v: They asked for a fax to 34-91-555-2033 or to accept emailed PDF. They also said they need the employees member ID printed.

samir: I can run a quick ID verification. Two options: 1) Ivy sends the verification letter to the clinic fax/email; 2) We temporarily add your passport number to benefits record for verification and issue a virtual ID PDF that contains a verification code clinics can call our benefits line to confirm. Which do you prefer?

nora v: Fax would be fastest. Please include member ID.

ivy: Sending now. Letter includes: Redwood Core PPO, Group 879453, Employer EIN 27-1345678, Member: Nora Vasquez (EmpID 10421), Member ID: R-10421-7, Effective 2025-09-01. Faxing to +34 91 555 2033 and emailing clerk@clinic-madrid.es.

diego: If they still insist on an EOB, let them know we can provide a pre-billing EOB stub that shows plan payments/explanations once claim is submitted. For urgent care we commonly issue a "pre-EOB" verification that outlines estimated coverage; it's not the final adjudicated EOB but clinics accept it for scheduling and pre-billing.

nora v: They accepted the fax and scheduled me in. Thank you. Quick follow-up  will my out-of-pocket apply or can I request a claim advance?

people-ops-bot: Note: Emergency claim advances are available for travel urgent care. Submit an advance request via portal -> Claims -> Request Advance, or email urgent-benefits@redwood.ai with subject "Advance Request - Nora V - PO-8012". Approval target: 48 hours.

samir: Also file the claim after treatment and upload the itemized invoice. If charged in EUR, include the exchange rate used (service date). If there is a billing dispute, save the clinic receipt and the fax confirmation; we'll attach both to the claim appeal.

ivy: Case logged: PO-8012  Temporary verification faxed and virtual ID option offered. Replacement physical card will be ordered to your home address; confirm DM with postal address when youre back in the US.

nora v: Got it. Appreciate the help and the fast fax. I'll DM my address for the replacement card. :relieved:
